About Us

Architecting the
Digital Frontier

Yantrixa is a fast-growing software and IT startup founded by visionary engineering students from Sree Buddha College of Engineering (Autonomous), Alappuzha. We combine raw technical talent with enterprise-scale architectural thinking.

Led by Balasankar (Founder) alongside Co-Founders Abhiram Gangadharan, Thejus R Raj, and Karthik Raj, Yantrixa is aggressively expanding its capabilities to offer world-class digital tools, platforms, and intelligent software hardware combinations.
